semiconductor_relevance: Medium — SYSTEC INOUE provides software solutions that enhance productivity and quality in semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on smart factory transitions.
summary: SYSTEC INOUE specializes in system solutions for the semiconductor manufacturing industry, focusing on managing and optimizing production processes through advanced technologies like IoT and AI. Their offerings include Manufacturing Execution Software (MES), production control software, and cell controller software, which support the transition to Smart Factories.
